title: DD_IAST_VULNERABILITIES_PER_REQUEST's hard upper bound of 64 is undocumented
claim: README.md:117 documents DD_IAST_VULNERABILITIES_PER_REQUEST as "Integer greater than or equal to 1" with no stated upper bound, but internal/config/config.go:34,75 clamps it to [1, MaxVulnerabilitiesPerRequest] where MaxVulnerabilitiesPerRequest = 64. Setting it to 1000000 silently resolves to 64 with a warning; this hard cap is never mentioned in the README, contrary to internal/config/AGENTS.md's requirement that the documentation accurately describe every environment variable's accepted values.
